card.name: Start of a split compound word
card.fires_on: The first piece of a word that gets split, such as 'land' in mainland, 'Mar' in Red Marrow and 'Cum' in Cumulative. It fires on the piece right before the word's rest, often in tables or headings.

modes.label: Body and dose terms
modes.description: Word starts in dosimetry tables or dose headings, just before the rest of the word.

modes.label: Other split words
modes.description: Pieces of ordinary words or names that continue in the next piece.

card.writes: It promotes word-continuation pieces like 'opsis' and 'aurus' and suppresses unrelated junk pieces, so it favors finishing a split word.
card.plain: It marks a word that is only partly written so far, such as 'Red Mar' waiting for 'row'.
